req.title: Login sets session on success
req.statement: The system shall set session['user_id'] and redirect to / when POST /auth/login receives a matching username and password.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a successful login should set the session['user_id'] and redirect to the homepage. Tests are designed to cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_login_success
preconditions: User Rahul with password 'stone' exists in the database
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    assert sess['user_id'] == 1

tests.name: test_login_incorrect_password
preconditions: User Rahul with password 'stone' exists in the database
actions: POST /auth/login with username 'Rahul' and incorrect password 'wrong'
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'wrong'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Incorrect password.' in r.data
with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    assert 'user_id' not in sess
